kill_history.detail: Spearman(core6, median_margin) = +1.00, exact p = 0.0028; Spearman(core6, frac<0.005) = -1.00, exact p = 0.0028 -- both at n=6 exact-permutation lower bound

Same metrics on Qwen3-8B six-rung ladder: rho = +0.43 (p=0.42) and -0.49 (p=0.36). Signs correct but effect strength collapses to non-significant. Per-rung margin distributions non-monotone in damage (step20000 has smaller median than step2000; scratch14L has larger median than any f12k2 rung). Rungs still core6-ordered, so aggregate degradation replicates; per-item margin compression does not.

olmo_only_finding.claim: On the OLMo-2-7B keepN + shortgpt16 ladder, aggregate core6 degradation is accompanied by per-item acc_norm margin compression. Both Spearman metrics hit the n=6 exact-permutation lower bound.
olmo_only_finding.scope: OLMo-2-7B specifically; does not extend to Qwen3-8B
olmo_only_finding.recommended_home: fold into Paper B methods appendix or the A01 null-cal spin-out; not stand-alone-paper material

resurrection_conditions: a second confirming family (NOT Qwen; that has already failed)
a mechanism-level hypothesis for why the compression is family-general, tested a priori

novelty_check_2026_08_09.rationale: OLMo-2-narrowed per-item acc_norm margin fingerprint on prune-heal ladder is not preempted by any verified peer-reviewed prior work (closest is Tropeano 2026 TMLR, which uses ECE/Brier aggregate calibration on attention-only prune without heal; measurement family is disjoint). But OLMo-2-only scope after Qwen kill is too narrow for stand-alone paper. Needs a 2nd non-Qwen family AND a mechanism-level hypothesis before promotion.

novelty_check_2026_08_09.kill_definition: A paper is a kill iff it (1) uses depth-prune-then-heal (not just prune-only or attention-only) on >=3 rungs, (2) reports per-item acc_norm (or equivalent length-normalized) margin distribution on MC tasks, AND (3) reports either median_margin or frac(margin<threshold) co-varying with aggregate score on that ladder. None of the top-5 or also-noted set satisfies all three. Concurrent (<=3mo, arXiv only) same-lens work on a different family is NOT a kill.

resurrection_gate_still_stands.second_confirming_family_NOT_qwen: required; e.g. Llama-3 or Mistral prune-heal ladder
resurrection_gate_still_stands.mechanism_level_hypothesis: required a priori; candidate: fresh-layer-init variance shapes logit dispersion, which in turn shapes margin compression under damage

main_independent_verification_2026_08_09.refinement_2_madaan: OpenReview returns THREE records for this title: RegML 2024 workshop (venueid NeurIPS.cc/2024/Workshop/RegML), CoRR 2024, AND ICLR.cc/2025/Conference/Rejected_Submission. Workshop claim is correct, but the paper was REJECTED at ICLR 2025. Do not treat its negative result about IRT/item-analysis failing on MMLU as settled -- which if anything leaves more room for B04 per-item margin lens.
